selected_cases.scope: Selected affected cases, not the complete acceptance library.

prior_tool_failure.reason: Godot editor settings path was empty; isolated APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA added to acceptance runner.

current_snapshot.stage: Before later nursing work-segment, original-room identity and surgical-guidance repairs; not final full-contract performance acceptance.

visual.scope: Static real render and read-only UI; no FPS or mouse end-to-end claim.

chains_timing_scope: Functional execution concurrent with another isolated functional batch; not a performance comparison.
evidence_reuse: Earlier selected evidence is reused only for unchanged rule/call-path meanings; latest automatic-life, layout, original-room and surgical guidance evidence supersedes older affected cases.

GROW-48/75/83 completed without script errors in their own cases. Their batch failed from GROW-11 invalid overlapping-room input; GROW-11 was repaired and rerun alone. No whole-batch success is claimed.
The early RESULT-05 passed in a batch with a failed LIFE-05 and exit-time resources still held. Final independent RESULT-05 clean execution supersedes it.
Historical v3 performance predates final functionality; no additional performance run before independent review.
